description:
## Why This Exists

commands/xget.rs returns response code 290 for a successful XGET. RFC 3977 §3.2 specifies that response codes must be registered or X-prefixed. The code 290 is not defined by any RFC 3977 extension. RFC 3977 §3.2.1 says codes 200-299 indicate successful responses, but the specific code 290 is not assigned.

For an X-prefixed command (XGET), the response code should follow existing convention. RFC 3977 §8.7 (XHDR, XOVER) use codes in the existing 200/220/221 range. Using 290 violates the IANA registry.

## Acceptance Criteria

Change XGET success response to an appropriate standard code (e.g. 220 matching ARTICLE, or 221 for headers-only). Update tests accordingly.
title: xget.rs: 290 response code is non-standard; RFC 3977 reserves 2xx for defined responses
